# The CHOP by Smash Wraps

The CHOP is a 109 mm straight rice-paper tube with flavor contained in a capsule tip. It comes in 1 g and 2 g sizes with three tubes per retail box. Adults 21+ where required.

## Core Facts
- Product Category: Rolling paper tubes
- Format: 109 mm straight tube, three tubes per box
- Sizes: 1 g and 2 g
- Flavor Profiles: Iced Watermelon, Passion Fruit, Pineapple, Vanilla
- Flavor Delivery: Pinch-activated capsule in tip; no sprayed wrap coating
- Audience: Adults 21+ where required
